scope: Reuse upstream Composio MCP skill references and hydrate any deferred input schema for bounded connected-action candidates before planning in the existing Xroga runtime.

keep: Canonical scheduler, tenant-bound Composio session adapter, approvals and execution
extend: Upstream deferred-schema inspection contract before action argument planning

auth.description: Existing authenticated route and actor admission.

tenant.description: Schema lookups use the same issued tenant and connected candidates.

approval.description: Existing exact confirmation and dispatch checks remain in force.

credentials.description: No new credentials or OAuth grants.

egress.description: Bounded calls to existing Composio metadata endpoint; no remote snippets or shell execution.

cost.description: Additional metadata-only requests capped at ten when discovery does not include schemas; no new model calls or paid-tool policy.

tests.scope: Hydrates full tool input before model dispatch and fails safely on missing metadata.

architecture.reason: Uses the same session API, canonical planner and consent boundaries, with upstream references checked in separately.

rollout: Use the dedicated feature branch. Run exact-source CI and verify a signed-in isolated paired frontend/API before inviting manual testing or promoting to production.
rollback: Revert the single adoption commit or leave production on the existing revision.
knownGaps: Vendored skill files are references, not an enabled remote agent.
Live provider-backed integration and every toolkit operation are not certified.
No OwnPilot default identity, unrestricted batching, remote bash or permission-bypass configs are imported.

blockers: Exact-source CI and an authorized isolated Composio Workspace acceptance window are outstanding.
